Package model.description

Class DPrimitive

java.lang.Object
model.logic.abstraction.AbstractFormal
model.description.abstraction.AbstractDescribed
model.description.DPrimitive
All Implemented Interfaces:
Comparable<Formal>, Described, Formal
public class DPrimitive extends AbstractDescribed
A description object of a primitive mathematical object. This class relies except for constructors and clone very much on it's abstract base class.

  • Constructor Details

    • DPrimitive

      public DPrimitive(String onecharacter)
      Creates a description object for the mathematical value corresponding to a specific UTF codepoint. For example it could be an ordinary literal used as a variable but could also be an integral operator corresponding to the character for the integral sign.
      Parameters:
      onecharacter - String beginning with the specific character.

    • DPrimitive

      public DPrimitive(int codepoint)
      Creates a description object for the mathematical value corresponding to a specific UTF codepoint. For example it could be an ordinary literal used as a variable but could also be an integral operator corresponding to the character for the integral sign.
      Parameters:
      codepoint - The UTF codepoint corresponding to this described mathematics.

    • DPrimitive

      public DPrimitive(int codepoint, double baseline, boolean transparent)
      Creates a description object of a mathematical value and the description are scaled to fit on the font baseline length given. The mathematical entity corresponds to an UTF codpoint. See
      Parameters:
      codepoint - The UTF codepoint corresponding to this described mathematics.
      baseline - The baseline length that this mathematical description (symbol) should fit onto.
      transparent - If the descriptions background should be rendered transparent or not.

    • DPrimitive

      public DPrimitive(Formal formal)
      Creates a standard size description object to the mathematical formal value given. That formal corresponds to an UTF codepoint.
      Parameters:
      formal - The object representing a formal piece of mathematics that should be described.
